providers.name: Microsoft
providers.note: The real account. Skins, capes and friends everywhere.
providers.browser: Alpinoxi opens your browser and waits for Microsoft to hand back a token. No password is typed into the launcher.

providers.name: Ely.by
providers.note: Skins through Ely.by, client id alpinoxi-client.
providers.browser: Ely.by sign-in opens in your browser. The launcher only ever sees the token, never your password.

providers.name: Cracked
providers.note: No account needed. Skins only where the server accepts them.
